method: Independent direct dimensional and scalar calculations, not a simulator output

hbf-latency-prefetch.arithmetic: 1e12 bytes/s × 20e-6 s = 20e6 bytes = 20 MB. 1024/16384 = 1/16 = 6.25%. Rates and request sizes are synthetic; page reuse invalidates the no-reuse efficiency assumption.
claims: The internal simulation limitation and absence of general latency/page defaults remain explicit.
hbf-latency-prefetch.dependency: Read-tier and hierarchy prerequisites preserve distinct transfer boundaries; placement permits a read-oriented scenario without asserting physically read-only NAND.

hbf-read-tier-contract.arithmetic: 100e9 bytes / 1e12 bytes/s = 0.1 s payload-only floor. A positive usable rate, single direction and compatible decimal units are required.
claims: Announced capacity/grades/interface remain dated and qualified; neither the announcement nor a common link establishes a volume-shipping workload result.
hbf-read-tier-contract.dependency: Interface-choice and link-compatibility prerequisites separate bandwidth arithmetic from negotiated compatibility. Geometry is an abstract topology, not a disclosed floorplan.

hbm-base-phy-controller.arithmetic: 1/(8e9 transfers/s) = 125e-12 s. 32 × 64 = 64 × 32 = 2048 data bits. Capacity does not enter the unit-interval calculation.
claims: The named PHY datasheet directly supports its aggregate width and channel partition; no deployed performance is inferred.
The 2024 base-die collaboration is a dated announcement, not proof of current qualification or allocation.
hbm-base-phy-controller.dependency: Controller and stack-assembly prerequisites preserve scheduling versus physical signaling versus storage ownership. The timing-margin expression is a declared illustrative additive budget, not a signoff equation.

hbm-tc-ncf-route.arithmetic: Twelve strictly serial placements at (0.3+0.7) s plus 3 s handling = 15 s occupied time. Parallel stations or batch curing would invalidate this serial occupancy prediction.
claims: The announced named route and sampling date are supported; production was a plan in that source.
hbm-tc-ncf-route.dependency: Bump-joint and stack-height prerequisites preserve metallic conduction, insulating film and counted interfaces. The enlarged bond-line drawing and synthetic occupancy are not a process window.
